q1: SELECT MAX(NUM) AS NUM FROM (SELECT NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM HAVING COUNT(NUM) = 1) AS T
q2: WITH T AS (SELECT COUNT(NUM) AS CNT,NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM) SELECT MAX(T.NUM) AS NUM FROM MYNUMBERS M LEFT JOIN T ON T.NUM =M.NUM AND T.CNT =1
